title: For the RBAC action access_as_shared, list the top 10 RBAC-own
question: For the RBAC action access_as_shared, list the top 10 RBAC-owning tenants (by number of distinct networks referenced by that action) and show, for each tenant: (1) the number of distinct networks referenced, (2) the average subnet IP version, (3) the subnet IP version range (max minus min), (4) the variance of subnet IP version considering only public RBAC entries where target_tenant = '*', and (5) the overall variance of subnet IP version across all subnets on networks referenced by that tenant’s RBAC entries for the action. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT r.tenant_id, r.object_id, r.target_tenant
  FROM networkrbacs r
  WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT object_id) AS distinct_networks
  FROM base
  GROUP BY tenant_id
  ORDER BY distinct_networks DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
all_sub AS (
  SELECT b.tenant_id, s.ip_version
  FROM base b
  JOIN subnets s ON s.network_id = b.object_id
),
pub_sub AS (
  SELECT b.tenant_id, s.ip_version
  FROM base b
  JOIN subnets s ON s.network_id = b.object_id
  WHERE b.target_tenant = '*'
)
SELECT
  r.tenant_id,
  r.distinct_networks,
  AVG(a.ip_version) AS avg_ip_version,
  MAX(a.ip_version) - MIN(a.ip_version) AS ip_version_range,
  VAR_SAMP(p.ip_version) AS variance_public,
  VAR_SAMP(a.ip_version) AS variance_all
FROM ranked r
LEFT JOIN all_sub a ON a.tenant_id = r.tenant_id
LEFT JOIN pub_sub p ON p.tenant_id = r.tenant_id
GROUP BY r.tenant_id, r.distinct_networks
ORDER BY r.distinct_networks DESC, r.tenant_id
LIMIT 10
